home.title: The feeling of home
home.hero_title: The feeling of home. The beauty of living.
home.hero_description: Interiors shaped by natural materials, careful proportions and the way you live.
home.material_description: Natural grain. An open weave. Light across a quiet surface. A few thoughtful choices give a room its character.
home.craft_detail_description: Cane, wood and tactile fabrics bring a softer rhythm to everyday spaces. Let their natural character stay visible.
home.craft_space_description: Look beyond the photograph. Consider how a space welcomes people, holds a conversation and changes through the day.
home.work_description: Four concept studies. Real reference photography. A feeling carried from the first view to the smallest detail.
home.service_one_body: Start with the way a room is used, the light it receives and the feeling it should create.
home.service_two_body: Bring layout, materials and proportion into one clear direction.
home.service_three_body: Consider lighting, furniture and finishes together, so every decision belongs.
home.service_four_body: Keep comfort and practical life at the centre of the final arrangement.
home.origin_title: A quieter way to see a space
home.origin_description: We are drawn to rooms that feel easy to be in. Spaces where the materials have depth and the details never compete.
home.origin_description_two: This fictional studio brings that perspective to life as a website concept. The care in the presentation can become the first impression of your own practice.

work.title: Selected concepts
work.page_lead: Four different spaces. One shared attention to how we live, gather, and feel.

studio.title: The studio
studio.page_lead: We believe a space earns its character through light, material and the way it is used.
studio.statement_title: Good design leaves room for life.
studio.statement_body: Not every surface needs a statement. The rooms we return to are often the ones that feel easy: warm to the touch, generous with daylight, and clear in their purpose.
studio.light_body: Notice where it falls in the morning and how it changes later. Let openings, curtains and surfaces work with it.
studio.texture_body: Wood grain, an open weave, a quiet piece of stone. A few honest materials can give a room all the depth it needs.
studio.proportion_body: Consider what sits beside what. The space around a chair can matter as much as the chair itself.
studio.closing_body: A clear brief, careful decisions, and attention to the small things. Explore the approach behind these concept spaces.

process.title: Our approach
process.page_lead: A clear idea, shaped carefully. An approach that makes room for both feeling and practical life.
process.step_one_title: Listen to the life behind the space.
process.step_one_body: How will the room be used? What needs to feel different? Start with the daily routines, priorities and small frustrations that a floor plan cannot tell us.
process.step_two_body: Explore the arrangement, light and materials together. Look at how one choice changes another, until the space feels coherent.
process.step_three_body: Refine finishes, junctions, lighting and furniture. Keep returning to the original intention so the small decisions support the whole.
process.closing_body: Not because little thought went into it, but because every choice belongs.

projects.name: Timber & Light
projects.detail_caption: A closer look at the cane seating. Detail crop from the same reference photograph.
projects.alt: Sunlit timber room with cane seating, green plants and a glazed staircase
projects.intro: Timber, woven cane and generous planting create a room that feels relaxed without feeling unfinished. Daylight does most of the work.
projects.story: The interest comes from a small set of textures: smooth glass, open weave, natural grain. Soft upholstery gives the room a place to pause.
projects.detail: Furniture sits lightly in the room. The view through the staircase and the tall planting give this home concept a sense of openness.

projects.name: The Quiet Apartment
projects.tagline: A little distance from the city.
projects.detail_caption: Chair, curtains and daylight. Detail crop from the same reference photograph.
projects.alt: Two cream lounge chairs beside a tall window with soft curtains and a glass table
projects.intro: Two comfortable chairs, a wide window, and a gentle palette. This apartment concept makes room for an unhurried moment.
projects.story: Sheer curtains soften the light without closing the room off. Muted upholstery and warm timber keep the contrast calm.
projects.detail: A glass tabletop keeps the centre open. Curved seating and layered curtains bring the arrangement together without adding visual weight.

projects.name: The Open Residence
projects.detail_caption: A second view of the dining space. Reference photography by Daniel Lee.
projects.alt: Light-filled living and dining space with a curved doorway and glazed doors
projects.intro: A connected living and dining space, softened by curves and natural light. A villa concept built around the pleasure of spending time together.
projects.story: The curved opening gives the room a quiet focal point. Pale surfaces carry daylight across the space, while darker furniture provides definition.
projects.detail: Long curtains, a textured rug and gentle lighting balance the room’s harder surfaces. The result feels composed, but never rigid.

projects.name: The Gathering Place
projects.detail_caption: Timber seating and a place at the table. Detail crop from the same reference photograph.
projects.alt: Bright restaurant with pale timber chairs, planted ceiling slats and neatly set tables
projects.intro: Pale timber, layered planting and welcoming light. A restaurant concept where the atmosphere matters as much as the table.
projects.story: Repeated timber lines bring order to the room. Planting softens the ceiling, while open sightlines keep the dining space connected.
projects.detail: Lightweight chairs and carefully spaced tables give the room an informal rhythm. The materials are familiar; the arrangement makes them feel considered.
